beats.tr: Matkap kayaya iner, uç dönmeye başlar.
beats.en: The drill comes down to the rock and the bit spins up.

beats.tr: Besleme kuvvetiyle uç kayaya girer; toz dışarı atılır.
beats.en: The feed force pushes the bit into the rock; the cuttings are thrown out.

beats.tr: Sıkışma! Tork sınırı aşıldı: uç geri çekilir, besleme azalır.
beats.en: Stall! Torque over the limit: the bit retracts and the feed is lowered.
It switches to percussive mode and reaches 5 cm.

beats.tr: Toz numune tüpe alınır ve laboratuvara gider. (Simülasyon)
beats.en: The powder sample goes into a tube and on to the lab. (Simulation)

note: Shows how the instrument works; numbers are the SCENARIO model's story, not a measurement.
